_note: Fictional FAQ for the demo company Bramble & Co. Replace with the client's real help-centre articles.

entries.question: When will my order be dispatched?
entries.answer: Orders are usually dispatched within 2 working days, and we email a tracking link as soon as the parcel leaves us.

entries.question: How do I return an item and get a refund?
entries.answer: Unused items can be returned within 30 days for a full refund. Refunds are issued within 5 working days of the return reaching us.

entries.question: My item arrived damaged or broken. What should I do?
entries.answer: Please send us a photo of the damage and we will replace or refund the item at no cost to you.

entries.question: Do you offer wholesale or trade prices?
entries.answer: Yes, we offer trade prices for cafes, shops and restaurants on orders of 24 or more units of the same item. Our trade team sends the price list on request.

entries.question: How do pottery workshop bookings work?
entries.answer: Pottery workshops run on Saturdays from 10:00 to 12:30. Places are booked and paid for on our website.

entries.question: Can I cancel or change my order?
entries.answer: Orders can be changed or cancelled free of charge until they are dispatched. Cancelled items are refunded to the original payment method.

entries.question: Do you ship outside the UK?
entries.answer: We currently ship to the UK and Ireland only.

entries.question: How do gift cards work?
entries.answer: Gift cards are emailed to the recipient within one hour of purchase and are valid for 12 months.

entries.question: How should I care for stoneware mugs and bowls?
entries.answer: Our stoneware is dishwasher and microwave safe. Hand washing keeps speckled glazes looking new for longer.

entries.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
entries.answer: We accept debit and credit cards, PayPal and Apple Pay at checkout.
